prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Rebuild ONLY the horse's gallop leg motion in the FIRST attached sprite sheet. The second sheet is the approved WALK and supplies exact horse/rider identity, proportions, costume and camera; do not alter the walk sheet. Keep the red-capped Russian mounted spearman, cream fur collar, red tunic, pale trousers, brown boots, held stone-tipped spear, bay horse, black mane/tail, white forehead mark and primitive tack. Maintain the same painterly game-sprite rendering and strictly straight vertical overhead view, horse head toward bottom and tail toward top.

Output exactly 1536x1024 transparent RGBA: three columns by two rows, SIX 512x512 animation cells in chronological reading order, one complete mounted rider in each. One continuous right-lead transverse HORSE GALLOP, not six unrelated running poses. Keep one fixed anatomical saddle/root position and consistent body scale throughout; slight fore-aft body rocking and rider lean are fine. All horse legs have persistent identities and originate at the correct shoulder or hip joints. Four horse legs total, separate from the two rider boots. Horse hooves travel in restrained smooth fore-aft arcs beside/under the body; never float or pop above the rump beside the tail. In overhead view the hindlegs are largely occluded by the horse's rump and rider, with only anatomically connected lower-leg portions visible near the rear flanks. No new leg emerging out of the horse's back.

Use a coherent right-lead four-beat sequence with ONE gathered suspension per stride: left hind contact, right hind push, left fore contact, right fore lead contact, right fore push-off, gathered airborne return into the next left hind contact. Six successive key poses:
1. Left hind reaches forward under rear flank and lands, right hind prepares to push; forelegs are recovering tucked under chest.
2. Right hind pushes, body extends slightly, both forelegs reach forward with the right fore farther forward.
3. Left fore contacts beneath the left shoulder, right fore continues the lead reach, hindlegs recover naturally under the rump.
4. Right fore contacts farther forward beside muzzle, left fore folds/retracts, hindlegs gather under the body.
5. Right fore completes push-off and bends into recovery; all four limbs start gathering, body rocks slightly.
6. Single gathered airborne phase, limbs bent under the body; left hind begins the next forward landing. Frame6 must connect smoothly to frame1. NEVER change lead between frames, mirror the horse or alternate left/right gallop cycles. NO hind hooves sticking above the horse's back. NO extreme sideways splay, disconnected hooves, extra limbs or abrupt swapping of front and rear feet.

Keep the rider's spear in the same ready position through the loop, not an attack. Preserve the horse length and rider size of the approved walk. Every COMPLETE silhouette including tail, all hooves and spear tip fits inside a centered 410x410 box in its cell with at least 51px completely transparent margin on each edge. Exact consistent cell placement; no neighboring pose can intrude into a cell. Truly transparent background, no ground, shadow, glow, vignette, grid, text, numbering or blood.
reason: User rejected horse hoof motion; rebuild continuous leg sequence while preserving approved walk
